section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Suspension (Upper Arm)
ocr_text:
RA-68

REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Suspension (Upper Arm)

4. TEMPORARILY CONNECT NO.2 LOWER SUSPENSION ARM

5. TEMPORARILY CONNECT STRUT ROD

6. TORQUE UPPER ARM MOUNTING NUT
Torque: 1,100 kg·cm (80 ft·lb, 108 N·m)

7. CONNECT SHOCK ABSORBER
Torque: 1,400 kg·cm (101 ft·lb, 137 N·m)

8. CONNECT PARKING BRAKE CABLE
(a) Connect parking brake cable to the parking brake cable equalizer.
(b) Install the two parking brake cable bracket to the body.

9. INSTALL REAR DRIVE SHAFT
(See page RA-21)
